title: The Trial, Crucifixion, and Burial of Jesus

questions.question: When Judas saw that Jesus was condemned, he changed his mind and brought back the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests. What did they say?
options: "What is that to us? See to it yourself."
"You are a traitor to your own master."
"Keep the money, you have earned it."
"We accept your repentance, go in peace."
questions.correctAnswer: "What is that to us? See to it yourself."
questions.explanation: Matthew 27:3-4 (ESV): "They said, 'What is that to us? See to it yourself.'"

questions.question: What did Judas do after throwing the money into the temple?
options: He departed, and he went and hanged himself
He fled the country to Egypt
He begged Pilate to release Jesus
He joined the crowd demanding crucifixion
questions.correctAnswer: He departed, and he went and hanged himself
questions.explanation: Matthew 27:5 (ESV): "And throwing down the pieces of silver into the temple, he departed, and he went and hanged himself."

questions.question: The chief priests could not put the silver into the treasury since it was "blood money", so they bought what with it?
options: The potter's field as a burial place for strangers
A new altar for the temple
More sacrifices for the Passover
Weapons to fight the Romans
questions.correctAnswer: The potter's field as a burial place for strangers
questions.explanation: Matthew 27:7 (ESV): "So they took counsel and bought with them the potter's field as a burial place for strangers."

questions.question: When the governor, Pontius Pilate, asked Jesus "Are you the King of the Jews?", what did Jesus answer?
options: "You have said so."
"I am the King of the universe."
"I am no earthly king."
"No, Caesar is king."
questions.explanation: Matthew 27:11 (ESV): "And the governor asked him, 'Are you the King of the Jews?' Jesus said, 'You have said so.'"

questions.question: At the feast, the governor was accustomed to release one prisoner for the crowd. Who was the notorious prisoner they asked to be released instead of Jesus?
options: Barabbas
Simon the Zealot
Dismas the thief
Judas of Galilee
questions.explanation: Matthew 27:16-17 (ESV): "And they had then a notorious prisoner called Barabbas... Pilate said to them, 'Whom do you want me to release for you: Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?'"

questions.question: Whose wife sent word to Pilate saying, "Have nothing to do with that righteous man, for I have suffered much because of him today in a dream"?
options: Pilate's wife
The High Priest's wife
Herod's wife
An elder's wife
questions.explanation: Matthew 27:19 (ESV): "Besides, while he was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent word to him, 'Have nothing to do with that righteous man, for I have suffered much because of him today in a dream.'"

questions.question: When Pilate saw he was gaining nothing and that a riot was beginning, what symbolic act did he perform before the crowd?
options: He took water and washed his hands, saying, "I am innocent of this man's blood;"
He tore his Roman cloak
He broke a rod in half
He threw a piece of silver on the ground
questions.correctAnswer: He took water and washed his hands, saying, "I am innocent of this man's blood;"
questions.explanation: Matthew 27:24 (ESV): "So when Pilate saw that he was gaining nothing... he took water and washed his hands before the crowd, saying, 'I am innocent of this man's blood; see to it yourselves.'"

questions.question: How did the crowd respond to Pilate saying he was innocent of Jesus' blood?
options: "His blood be on us and on our children!"
"Crucify him quickly!"
"We accept his blood!"
"He is not a righteous man!"
questions.correctAnswer: "His blood be on us and on our children!"
questions.explanation: Matthew 27:25 (ESV): "And all the people answered, 'His blood be on us and on our children!'"

questions.question: When the soldiers led Jesus into the governor's headquarters to mock Him, what three items did they array Him with as "King"?
options: A scarlet robe, a crown of thorns, and a reed in his right hand
A purple cloak, an iron crown, and a golden scepter
A white garment, a wreath of laurel, and a sword
A beggar's rags, a dirty hat, and a wooden staff
questions.correctAnswer: A scarlet robe, a crown of thorns, and a reed in his right hand
questions.explanation: Matthew 27:28-29 (ESV): "...put a scarlet robe on him, and twisting together a crown of thorns, they put it on his head and put a reed in his right hand. And kneeling before him, they mocked him, saying, 'Hail, King of the Jews!'"

questions.question: As they went out to crucify Him, who did they compel to carry His cross?
options: A man of Cyrene, Simon by name
John, the beloved disciple
Nicodemus the Pharisee
A Roman soldier named Longinus
questions.correctAnswer: A man of Cyrene, Simon by name
questions.explanation: Matthew 27:32 (ESV): "As they went out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name. They compelled this man to carry his cross."

questions.question: When they crucified Jesus, how did the soldiers divide His garments?
options: By casting lots
By tearing them into equal pieces
They gave them to his mother
They sold them to the highest bidder
questions.explanation: Matthew 27:35 (ESV): "And when they had crucified him, they divided his garments among them by casting lots."

questions.question: From the sixth hour to the ninth hour (noon to 3pm), what came over all the land?
options: Darkness
A terrible hailstorm
An unnatural silence
A swarm of locusts
questions.explanation: Matthew 27:45 (ESV): "Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land until the ninth hour."

questions.question: About the ninth hour Jesus cried out with a loud voice, "Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani?" What does that mean?
options: "My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?"
"Into your hands I commit my spirit."
"It is finished."
"Forgive them, for they know not what they do."
questions.correctAnswer: "My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?"
questions.explanation: Matthew 27:46 (ESV): "that is, 'My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?'" (Quoting Psalm 22:1)

questions.question: When Jesus yielded up His spirit, what dramatic event happened in the temple?
options: The curtain of the temple was torn in two, from top to bottom
The golden altar burst into unquenchable flame
The pillars of the temple cracked loudly
All the oil lamps went out simultaneously
questions.correctAnswer: The curtain of the temple was torn in two, from top to bottom
questions.explanation: Matthew 27:51 (ESV): "And behold, the curtain of the temple was torn in two, from top to bottom. And the earth shook, and the rocks were split."

questions.question: When the centurion and those who were with him saw the earthquake and what took place, what did they say?
options: "Truly this was the Son of God!"
"We have murdered an innocent man!"
"His blood will surely be required of us!"
"He was indeed a great prophet!"
questions.correctAnswer: "Truly this was the Son of God!"
questions.explanation: Matthew 27:54 (ESV): "When the centurion and those who were with him, keeping watch over Jesus, saw the earthquake and what took place, they were filled with awe and said, 'Truly this was the Son of God!'"

key_verse_text: When the centurion and those who were with him, keeping watch over Jesus, saw the earthquake and what took place, they were filled with awe and said, "Truly this was the Son of God!"
